name: pixelperfect-studio
description: Turn a flat image into a high-fidelity, editable, fixed-size HTML design. Rebuild meaningful components as separate HTML, CSS, SVG or embedded PNG layers. This is a static design canvas, not a responsive website.

interface.longDescription: Upload a poster, graphic, slide, cover or other visual. PixelPerfect Studio studies the reference, separates its meaningful components, recovers typography, extracts source details or creates individual PNG assets, and rebuilds the design on an exact-size fixed artboard. Each component remains separately addressable as an HTML/CSS, SVG or embedded image layer. This is an editable static design canvas, not a responsive website. The customer receives one verified offline-capable standalone HTML file only.
capabilities: Convert a flat image into a structured editable HTML design
Separate meaningful visual components into independent layers
Extract original image details and generate separate PNG assets when needed
Recover exact typography or extract source letterforms when necessary
Preserve the original fixed canvas dimensions and visual composition
Embed every required asset for offline standalone rendering
Render, inspect and verify before delivering one final HTML file
defaultPrompt: Turn this image into editable layered HTML at its original size. Deliver only the verified standalone HTML.
Separate each meaningful component. Extract visuals or generate individual PNG assets when needed.
Find the exact fonts or extract the visible letterforms from the reference.
